newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight market quiet, few orders sighted.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight market quiet, few orders sighted.

text.p: New sugar freight activity was thin on the ground on Tuesday with few new fixtures emerging, shipbrokers said.
E D & F Man entered the market with the only two new orders of the day, they said.

It quoted for 14,000 tonnes min/max bulk sugar from north or south Brazil to Algeria with Black Sea option for 27 September/5 October and for 20,000 tonnes of min/max bulk sugar from Fiji to Surabaya for the same dates.
